name: Rome
attacked: Ambitious. You seek to conquer me before I move on you. I approve.
denounced: You had better mean what you say. I, for one, do not make idle threats..!
introduction: I am Caesar, destroyer of conspiracies in the Alpine woods and the Senate alike.
tradeRequest: I offer this, for your consideration.

name: Shimang
declaringWar: Charge! Victory is only one glorious battle away!
attacked: You cannot declare war on me! I declared war first..!
defeated: Good... End me and give me honour...
introduction: Good evening, who are you? For I am the leader of Shimang.
tradeRequest: Gold? Iron? Weapons? Who knows what things we can get from this trade?
